Excel formula errors (#NAME?) in the statistics section caused the budget risk calculation to fail validation.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed because cells H46:L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected numeric risk metrics. This error typically indicates undefined named ranges or unsupported functions in the generated workbook. While basic sheet structure and lookup blocks passed, the final statistical matrix in the 'Task' worksheet contained multiple mismatches.
